fields.description: Turn call recordings into text a person or an external agent can read.
fields.label: Enable Transcription

fields.description: Transcribe every recording as soon as the provider hands it over. With this off, transcription only runs when asked for on a call.
fields.label: Transcribe Automatically

fields.description: ISO code of the language spoken on calls, for example it. Leave empty to let the model detect it, which is slower and less accurate on short calls.
fields.label: Language

fields.description: Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI audio-transcription API: a Whisper server you host yourself, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI. Only the URL and the key change.
fields.label: Endpoint

fields.description: Base URL up to and including the version, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:8000/v1 for a self-hosted Whisper.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Leave empty for a self-hosted endpoint that needs no authentication.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Optional hint passed to the model: names, jargon or product terms it should spell correctly.
fields.label: Vocabulary Hint

fields.description: Call content is personal data, and for a health practice it is a special category. Keep it only as long as there is a reason to.
fields.label: Retention

fields.description: Transcripts older than this are deleted nightly. 0 keeps them forever.
fields.label: Delete Transcripts After (days)

fields.description: Nightly, drops the recording link from calls older than this so the audio is no longer reachable from the CRM. 0 keeps the links. Deleting the audio at the provider is a separate step.
fields.label: Forget Recording Links After (days)

fields.description: Recordings larger than this are not sent. Guards both the provider's own limit and this server's memory.
fields.label: Maximum Recording Size (MB)

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the transcription to come back.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
